scope.rest: v1 SHA256 of compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON: ordered 78 joint_names, sorted bound_mesh_names, and name-sorted relevant frames. Each frame contains node name, parent name, and its original matrix (never decomposed) or explicit default-completed local TRS as float64 JSON numbers. Relevant frames are all joints, bound skinned mesh nodes, and all their ancestors. Node indices, children arrays, mesh/primitive references and buffer indices are excluded.
scope.inverse_binds: SHA256 of the original de-strided, little-endian FLOAT MAT4 accessor payload, exactly 78 matrices in skin.joints palette order; buffer indices/offsets, JSON metadata and padding are excluded.
scope.guard: SHA256 of little-endian float32 source values at an exact stored time key: 78 skin.joints in palette order, each translation xyz, rotation xyzw, scale xyz (234 complete TRS channels; 780 floats). No interpolation, quaternion normalization/sign change or rest fallback. Idle uses time 0; each attack uses entry 0 and exit 1.75 seconds.
